explanation: Memoize the maximum testable height for a given number of cases and drops. One drop splits the problem into break and survive branches, contributing F(c−1,d−1)+1+F(c,d−1); one case can test only a linear number of floors.
timeComplexity: O(CD) time for C cases and D drops.
spaceComplexity: O(CD) memo space and O(C+D) recursion-space upper bound.
